lines: Oh! You. You look like someone who's good at asking grown-ups for things.
I'm Melanie. I live in the house past Dash's. And I have a VERY serious problem.
Galaxity has a magic bubble bath, a zipline, a tree house, a rock wall, an observatory and a cloud you can nap on.
But no water slide. A water-park town with NO WATER SLIDE.
I've practised my most serious face. Look. (Melanie makes her most serious face.)
YES. Two serious faces are better than one.
His window's on the Town Hall, right behind me. He's only in from morning till teatime, so we have to catch him.
Okay. I'll keep practising my face. (She does it again.)
Mr. Palmer's window is right there on the Town Hall. Knock in the morning or the daytime.
Remember: serious face. No giggling. Giggling is how you lose a negotiation.
"Patience." PATIENCE! I've been patient since breakfast!
But did you see his face when I said "the old slide"? He went all twitchy.
There IS an old slide, out in the Spooky Woods by the Haunted House. All boarded up. Why? Ask around. Bramble, Pip and Dash know everything.
You're going to the Spooky Woods? On purpose? Brave.
I'll stay here and guard the Town Hall. Not because I'm scared. It just needs guarding.
You're going to the Spooky Woods? On purpose? Brave.
I'll stay here and guard the Town Hall. Not because I'm scared. It just needs guarding.
You're going to the Spooky Woods? On purpose? Brave.
I'll stay here and guard the Town Hall. Not because I'm scared. It just needs guarding.
{player}: Melanie! There was a fancy man, and the Haunted House door, and something GREEN and GIGGLY flew out!
Something flew out? Of the Haunted House? And you just... let it?
(Melanie thinks very hard. You can tell, because her ears do it too.)
Okay. New plan. Who said the slide has to go on the waterfall? Or in a spooky old house?
What if it FLOATS? A cloud, over the lake, with a slide spiralling down into the water!
And on top of the cloud... a toy store.
{player}: I thought toys were sooo 90s?
I've grown as a person. Go and tell Mr. Palmer! Morning or daytime. Use the face.
Go on! The cloud slide! With the toy store! Tell him before he goes to lunch!

rotate: We did it! A cloud slide! I'm going to go down it a thousand times. Then a thousand more.
Mr. Palmer says waiting made it better. I hate it when grown-ups are right.
Have you seen anything green and giggly around? Me neither. Probably nothing. Probably.
Serious face. (Melanie does it.) Still working on it.
